title: Obesity Treatment in a Managed Care Setting
brief_summary: The aim of the present study is to evaluate the effectiveness of two different delivery formats for weight management in a managed care setting. Mail-based weight counseling and phone-based weight counseling will be compared to each other and a control condition. Primary outcomes are participation rates in programs, weight change, and cost.
raw_criteria:
* at least 18 years of age
* BMI ≥ 27.8 kg/m2 for men
* BMI ≥ 27.3 kg/m2 for non-pregnant or lactating women
